version.approval_notes: Source is bundled with esbuild (not minified). Build: npm ci && npm run build -> dist/firefox. Public repo: https://github.com/zerobun0/sift

summary.en-US: Filter your YouTube feed before it loads: by length, Shorts, live, YouTube's own topics, categories and your own words. Switch between modes like Learn or Chill.

description.en-US:
Sift hides YouTube videos you don't want before the page draws them, so there's no flicker and no gaps.

- Length ranges (e.g. only 20-60 minute videos)
- Hide Shorts, live, upcoming, members-only, mixes, already watched
- Use the topic chips YouTube builds for you on the home page
- YouTube's 15 categories (optional free API key of your own)
- Hide or require title words, block or allow channels
- Modes you switch from the toolbar
- A small chip on YouTube shows what was hidden and why
- Local stats page

No account, no tracking, no servers. Everything stays in your browser.
